newsitem.title: MALTA: Suncrest Hotel listed on Malta exchange.
newsitem.headline: Suncrest Hotel listed on Malta exchange.

text.p: The Malta Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it had admitted the securities of Suncrest Hotel Plc on the official list.
These comprise 10 million ordinary shares of nominal 10c each and three million Malta pounds nominal ($7.8m) 8.25 percent Suncrest bonds 2005/2007.
Dealing in the securities is expected to start on April 16.
The shares and bonds went on sale in February, the issue being quickly subscribed.

The Suncrest, Malta's biggest hotel with 1,000 beds, is the first tourism-related company listed by the exchange. The other listed companies are three banks, an insurance company and a soft-drinks maker.
